title: What we teach, and how we know it is working
lead: The school follows the Maharashtra State Board syllabus, with a CBSE-informed pattern used in the lower classes to build a stronger foundation before the board years.

boards.title: Maharashtra State Board
boards.description: The syllabus followed through High School and Junior College, culminating in the Class X and Class XII board examinations.

boards.title: CBSE-informed foundation
boards.description: The lower classes are taught on a CBSE pattern, which strengthens language, conceptual mathematics and structured science before the board syllabus begins.

medium: English is the medium of instruction throughout the institution. Marathi and Hindi are taught as languages, with Sanskrit available as an option in the senior grades.

subjectGroups.title: Languages
subjectGroups.note: Language teaching is sequenced so that reading fluency arrives before comprehension is assessed.

subjectGroups.title: Mathematics
subjectGroups.note: Taught concrete → pictorial → abstract, with problem practice in every lesson.

subjectGroups.title: Science & Technology
subjectGroups.note: Practical work is timetabled, not optional. The physics and computer laboratories are in weekly use.

subjectGroups.title: Social Studies
subjectGroups.note: Taught with maps, sources and local field study wherever the topic allows it.

subjectGroups.title: Commerce
subjectGroups.note: The Junior College commerce stream, feeding directly into our BBA and BCCA programmes.

subjectGroups.title: Arts, Sport & Life Skills
subjectGroups.note: Given real time in the week. These are the subjects that build the personality the crest asks for.

assessment.title: Continuous assessment
assessment.description: Class work, homework, oral responses and practical journals are recorded through the term, so a report is never a surprise.

assessment.title: Unit tests & terminal examinations
assessment.description: Regular written assessment, marked against the board pattern from the middle school upward.

assessment.title: Practical & project work
assessment.description: Supervised laboratory work, exhibitions and project submissions, assessed on method as well as result.

assessment.title: Parent–teacher meetings
assessment.description: Scheduled each term, with the class teacher and subject teachers available to discuss the whole picture.

pedagogy.title: Activity-based learning
pedagogy.description: Interactive and hands-on methods across every section, so understanding is built rather than recited.

pedagogy.title: Smart classrooms
pedagogy.description: Technology-enabled teaching spaces used for demonstration, animation and revision.

pedagogy.title: Individual attention
pedagogy.description: Teachers are expected to know each child's pace, not only the class average.

pedagogy.title: Value education
pedagogy.description: Ethics, empathy and environmental responsibility taught explicitly and practised publicly.
